chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 The elder, unto the elect lady and her children whom I love in the truth — and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth VerseEnd Verse2 for the truth’s sake, which dwells in us and shall be with us for ever: VerseEnd Verse3 Grace be with you, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love. VerseEnd Verse4 I rejoiced greatly that I found your children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father. VerseEnd

Verse5 And now I implore you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto you, but that which we had from the beginning — that we love one another VerseEnd (Verse6 and this is love: that we walk after his commandments). This is the commandment that, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it. VerseEnd Verse7 For many deceivers are entered into the world who confess not that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist. VerseEnd Verse8 Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward. VerseEnd

Verse9 Whoever transgresses and abides not in the Doctrine of Christ has not God. He that abides in the Doctrine of Christ, he has both the Father and the Son. VerseEnd Verse10 If any come unto you and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him Godspeed, VerseEnd Verse11 for he that bids him Godspeed is partaker of his evil deeds. VerseEnd

Verse12 Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink, but I trust to come unto you and speak face to face, that our joy may be full. VerseEnd Verse13 The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen. VerseEnd
